@pytest.mark.parametrize("input_data,expected", TOOL_CALLS_VALIDATE_INPUT_CASES)
def test_tool_calls_validate_input(input_data, expected):
    """Test validate_input normalizes various LM output formats into the canonical format."""
    assert ToolCalls.validate_input(input_data) == expected


def test_tool_calls_validate_input_returns_python_structure():
    """validate_input should return normalized Python structures, not a ToolCalls instance."""
    tool_calls = ToolCalls(tool_calls=[{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}])
    result = ToolCalls.validate_input(tool_calls)
    assert not isinstance(result, ToolCalls)
    assert result == {"tool_calls": [{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}]}


def test_tool_calls_from_single_dict():
    """A single tool call object should be parsed into a ToolCalls instance."""
    tool_calls = ToolCalls(**{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}})
    assert tool_calls == ToolCalls(tool_calls=[{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}])


def test_tool_calls_from_bare_list():
    """A bare list of tool call objects should be parsed into a ToolCalls instance."""
    tool_calls = ToolCalls.model_validate(

            {"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}},
            {"name": "translate", "args": {"text": "world", "lang": "fr"}},
        ]
    )


def test_tool_calls_from_json_string():
    """A JSON string of tool calls should be parsed into a ToolCalls instance."""
    tool_calls = ToolCalls.model_validate('{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}')
    assert tool_calls == ToolCalls(tool_calls=[{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}])
